documents.title: FlipForge Product Overview
documents.headline: Know what the evidence supports before you buy.
documents.summary: FlipForge is a sports-card decision engine that turns exact-card identity, evidence, economics, risk, and outcomes into a defensible BUY, WATCH, VERIFY, or PASS decision.

documents.title: What Is Card Decision Intelligence?
documents.eyebrow: OWN THE DECISION — NOT JUST THE DATA
documents.headline: A price is a fact. A decision needs context.
documents.summary: Card Decision Intelligence™ is FlipForge’s governed process for moving from exact-card identity to evidence, economics, risk, decision reasoning, and tracked outcomes.

documents.title: Why FlipForge Exists
documents.headline: The market has plenty of data. The harder problem is knowing what deserves to count.
documents.summary: FlipForge exists because collectors and dealers are forced to translate prices, comps, opinions, and uncertainty into decisions without a consistent trust layer.

documents.title: How FlipForge Builds a Decision
documents.headline: From exact card to explainable action.
documents.summary: Each layer answers a different question. No single price, grade, or score is allowed to stand in for the whole decision.

documents.title: FlipForge for Dealers & Flippers
documents.headline: Inventory money deserves more than a good-looking comp.
documents.summary: Use Card Decision Intelligence™ to test identity, evidence, margin, liquidity, risk, and the next action before capital gets committed.

documents.title: FlipForge for Collectors & Investors
documents.eyebrow: BUY WITH REASONS YOU CAN INSPECT
documents.headline: Separate the card you want from the evidence you need.
documents.summary: FlipForge helps you understand whether the exact card, evidence, economics, and risk support BUY, WATCH, VERIFY, or PASS.

documents.title: Sample FlipForge Decision Dossier
documents.headline: VERIFY — the apparent deal does not survive evidence review.
documents.summary: A sample marketing dossier showing how an apparent 24% discount can fall to 2.3% after invalid comparisons are removed.
